item.title: The Cult Leader Who Ruled Through Fear
item.description: Roch Thériault founded the Ant Hill Kids in 1977 and claimed to be a prophet, eventually isolating followers in a remote Canadian commune. His rule involved severe abuse and violence, and he was convicted of second-degree murder in 1993 and sentenced to life in prison.

item.title: He Was Executed Despite Evidence He Was Innocent
item.description: Joe Arridy was executed in Colorado in 1939 after confessing to the murder of 15-year-old Dorothy Drain. He had an IQ of 46, and evidence later showed his confession was coerced and he likely was not in Pueblo when the crime occurred. In 2011, he received a full posthumous pardon.
